audit.whatIsWrong: The lane was rated EVEN 6/10 with Illaoi winning Level 1, and the chart did not match the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: Illaoi wins only 45.81% here, and the packet carries the defect 'level chart contradicts data: Illaoi wins only 45.81% but the chart gives Illaoi 6/7 stages vs 1'. The mirror (audits/top/singed__illaoi.json) has already been realigned to Singed / Skill / Illaoi / Illaoi / Skill / Illaoi / Singed and rates the matchup FAV 4/10 from Singed's side, so this page must read the same rows and the inverse rating.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3, 4 and 5 flipped in both layers as one atomic group to match the mirror exactly; diff to TRICKY, diffRating to 7/10, and the difficulty and final-rating prose brought with them.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike was written as a clean Illaoi window with no mention of what his ultimate does.
audit.why: Insanity Potion (R, 100s flat) 'makes his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds'. Illaoi's entire sustain is Prophet of an Elder God healing her off every Tentacle that connects, so from the moment he drinks, the fight she is built to win — a long grind inside her own field — is running at half healing. This is the exact interaction flagged in _missing (rule 'their-antiheal-blunts-you') and it was nowhere on the page.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds written into whys[4], the cooldown block and wants.foe[2]; level 6 restated as Skill rather than a free Illaoi window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page's core instruction is 'W Harsh Lesson dash onto him' (spikes[0], mid, wants.you[1]) with no mention of Mega Adhesive, and Fling is described only as 'his flip'.
audit.why: Riot on Mega Adhesive (W, 17/16/15/14/13s, 1000 range): it slows AND grounds enemies who walk on it. Harsh Lesson is a leap — grounded, it does not work, which kills the whole pattern the page tells you to run. Riot on Fling (E, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, 125 range): it flings you behind him, and 'if the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted'. The goo-then-Fling order is the sequence that kills Illaoi, and neither half was on the page. Poison Trail itself is 13 mana on a 0 cooldown, which is why the early chip is unanswerable rather than 'zero counterplay' for him.
audit.corrected: Grounding stated against Harsh Lesson in spikes[0], report[5] and the cooldown block; the Fling-into-goo root written into dosFull[0]; Poison Trail's 13-mana, no-cooldown reality written into whys[0] and early.
sources: audits/top/singed__illaoi.json (same finding from the other side)

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' and the page tracked 'Fling' with no number.
audit.why: Mega Adhesive 17s at rank 1 is the cooldown that actually decides whether you can leap; Fling is 10s; Insanity Potion 100s. Against Harsh Lesson at 4s and Test of Spirit at 16s, the sequencing line is: step out of goo, then leap.
audit.corrected: Real numbers and an explicit wait-for-X-before-Y line written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0] and spikes[0].

audit.why: The suspectNames entry flagging 'His Poison Trail' in spikes[0] is a false positive — Poison Trail is Riot's real name for Singed's Q. Left as written.

His Poison Trail does nothing to stop your tentacles hitting, so any extended trade in the 4-5 window is deeply in your favour.
edits.after: You have every tool to win the numbers game: land Q Tentacle Smash on the wave and on Singed as he steps in to Fling or poison-tick you, then W Harsh Lesson onto him to reset and slam a tentacle. Watch the goo, though — Mega Adhesive grounds, so the leap is dead while you stand in it; step out first and the 4-5 window is deeply in your favour.

edits.before: - Singed Fling: matchup-defining — His flip. Bait it, then slam. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Singed Mega Adhesive (17s at rank 1): it grounds, so Harsh Lesson cannot leap out of it. - Fling 10s: into the goo it roots. - Insanity Potion 100s adds Grievous. - Leap of Faith: kill windows only.

notes: The chart on this page was copied from the mirror's realigned version (Singed / Skill / Illaoi / Illaoi / Skill / Illaoi / Singed) rather than from this packet, whose chart the packet itself flags as contradicting a 45.81% win rate. The focus field still reads 'Singed Fling'; the cooldown that actually decides the lane is Mega Adhesive, because it grounds Harsh Lesson — worth a champion-level look at whether focus.text should move. Standing Illaoi flag misfires confirmed again by the mirror agent and left unwritten: Leap of Faith does not ground and does not grant untargetability, and Prophet of an Elder God does not create terrain (it spawns Tentacles on existing impassible terrain).
